title: Astra Microwave Products Ltd (ASTRAMICRO) — Institutional Investment Dossier
archetype: Tactical Defense RF & Radar Sub-System Specialist
primer: Astra Microwave Products Ltd. (ASTRAMICRO) builds RF and microwave sub-systems for Indian defence and space, holding a ₹4,708 Cr backlog and 29%–33% operating margins. However, a 537-day cash cycle left 12-year cumulative free cash flow at -₹46 Cr. At ₹1,703.50 (74.8x P/E) in Stage 3 topping, new capital is REJECTED on Valuation and Cash Flow. For the 180 held shares (7.14% weight), we recommend TRIM_INTO_STRENGTH: sell 90 shares now and guard the rest with a ₹1,539.80 hard stop.
holding_rationale: Zerodha holds 180 shares at ₹1,684.72 avg cost (₹3,06,630 value, 7.14% weight, +₹3,379.68 gain). Valuation (74.8x P/E) rejects new capital, and Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) with 6 distribution days warrants trimming 90 shares immediately. Hold remaining 90 shares behind a hard stop at ₹1,539.80.
